lines.zh: 细长的身体一摆，我窜出去。
lines.en: My slender body flexes and I dart off.
I thread between the reed stems in the shallows.

lines.zh: 尾巴摆得很急，像缝衣服的针。
lines.en: My tail flicks fast, like a sewing needle.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面游，背鳍露出来。
lines.en: I swim at the surface with my dorsal fin showing.
I turn sharp without disturbing the water.
I slip into a crevice and out again.

lines.zh: 河底的沙被我一扫就开。
lines.en: One flick and the river sand parts.
I push against the current.
I'm small enough to barely splash.
I pass under the fallen log.
I circle once around the weeds.

lines.zh: 河道窄的地方我走得更快。
lines.en: Where the channel narrows, I go faster.
I look up; there are bright patches on the surface.

lines.zh: 我从一群蝌蚪中间穿过去。
lines.en: I cut through a cloud of tadpoles.
My tail moves too fast to follow.
My snout is long and my mouth stays open.
Water passes my gills; I breathe slowly.
I rest in the shade of the weeds.
A bug fell in; I see it.

lines.zh: 我把身体横过来，稳住了。
lines.en: I turn side-on and hold steady.
The light on the bottom wavers.
I'm reading the current's speed.

lines.zh: 我的鳞很细，几乎看不出来。
lines.en: My scales are fine, almost invisible.
I sink half a foot.
Someone's walking along the bank.

lines.zh: 我细长的身子，停在水草间。
lines.en: My slender body hangs among the weeds.
A leaf has fallen on the water.

lines.zh: 我把尾尖轻轻扫了一下。
lines.en: I give my tail tip a light sweep.
You crouch at the bank and watch me.
I rise a little.
I won't leave unless you move.
Your fingers are nearly in the water.
I turn side-on for a better look.
I'm the only one of me in this water.
I'm at the edge of your shadow.

lines.zh: 水面上的眼睛，别一直盯着。
lines.en: Eyes above the water, don't keep staring.
One dart and I'm far back.

lines.zh: 侧腹挨了一下，我翻了个身。
lines.en: A blow to my flank, and I roll over.
One of my fins has collapsed.

lines.zh: 我的薄鳞被刮开，血散进水里。
lines.en: My thin scales are scraped open; blood drifts into the water.
I'm swimming crooked.
I still have strength in the water; not over.
This taste, I have noted it.
I duck into a crevice.
I head for that smell.
It's still moving — I want it alive.
Too small; one gulp.
Drop it and I'll take it.
I circle once before biting.
Best thing today.
Don't grab with your hand; I'm quick.
I sniff again and don't leave.

lines.zh: 你一动，水波把我推开了。
lines.en: You moved and the wave pushed me off.
I'm crowded against the stone.
I turn and my scales brush past you.
That knock dazed me.
I duck into deeper water.
Collisions underwater make no sound.

lines.zh: 你踩到底了，沙都翻起来。
lines.en: You hit the bottom and the sand billows.
I slide away with the wave.

lines.zh: 这一点水不够我们两个转身。
lines.en: There's not enough water here for both of us to turn.
I back off and steady myself.
Another slim shadow slides up.

lines.zh: 我们的尾摆成同一个节奏。
lines.en: Our tails beat the same rhythm.
It's dark under the weeds — just right.

lines.zh: 我们一同转向，一同停下。
lines.en: We turn together and stop together.
The water here is shallow and warm.
A thin film of light sits on the surface.
Afterwards we went our own ways.

lines.zh: 同一条河，我们顺着水走。
lines.en: Same river, and we follow the current together.
It slipped away from my mouth.
I swim a lap with it in my mouth.
So small I barely felt it go down.
This leaf isn't food.

lines.zh: 我把它吐出来，又叼回去。
lines.en: I spit it out and take it again.
I nudge it away with my snout.
It's stuck between my teeth.
I swallowed it, fast.

lines.zh: 我影子在水面下斜了一下。
lines.en: My shadow tilts under the surface.
I turn to face it squarely.
I keep my body low.
It's bigger than me; I'll need to be faster.
I slip along the weeds.
My long snout spears small fish.
At this distance I'm there in a flash.
The surface light happens to hide me.
I hold perfectly still.
It turned away — good.
I follow its wake.
It goes left; I circle underneath.
I've nearly stopped finning.
The current carries me toward it.
I close in bit by bit.
If it lunges, I'll dart.

lines.zh: 我收着尾，一点点贴过去。
lines.en: Tail held still, I press closer inch by inch.
Half a foot more.
I circle around its tail.
It's fast; I'm faster.

lines.zh: 水面下全是我们的影子。
lines.en: Our shadows fill the water.
I dart in and my teeth catch.
My snout stabs straight in.
A twist of my body throws it off.
That bite landed by its gills.
It tore free and blood clouds out.
My teeth are fine, but there are many.
Not even a splash.
In the Chinle river, I strike fast.
It hits the stone.
My body is still slender.
Light falls from the surface.
Weeds on every side.
I give my tail one beat first.
There's a shadow on the bank.
I press to the riverbed.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼从我面前跑掉。
lines.en: A small fish darts away from me.
The light at the surface is sharp.
I make a lap and learn the channel.
The water's shallow here.
I test my speed with a flick.

lines.zh: 我被甩到岸上，在石头上跳。
lines.en: I'm thrown onto the bank and flop on the stones.
Water has clogged my gills.

lines.zh: 水下的冲击把我翻过来。
lines.en: The blast underwater flips me.
Something sharp went clean through me.
Something turns inside me.

lines.zh: 水里没虫了，我游得很慢。
lines.en: No bugs left; I swim very slowly.

lines.zh: 雷进了水，我一下就僵了。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and stiffens me.
The riverbed is gone and I fall.
